case_name: Smt Chintamani Alias Priyanka W/O. ... vs Girish S/O Shankar Naik

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Chintamani @ Priyanka W/O. Girisha, aged about 29 years
parties.respondent_defendant: Girish S/O Shankar Naik, age 39 years

facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was solemnized on 29.04.2016. Disputes arose and petitioner started residing with her parents for two years prior to filing the present petition.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer of a case to establish that it is necessary for justice and equity.
legal_principles.held: It will be difficult for her to travel to Chikkamagaluru for the purpose of contesting M.C.12/2022 proceedings instituted by the husband before the Principal Judge, Family Court Chikkamagaluru.

legal_principles.principle: A party's ability to travel and contest a case is relevant in determining the necessity of transfer.
legal_principles.held: It will be difficult for her to travel to Chikkamagaluru for the purpose of contesting M.C.12/2022 proceedings instituted by the husband before the Principal Judge, Family Court Chikkamagaluru.

outcome.final_order: The present petition is allowed and M.C.No.12/2022, filed by the respondent pending on the file of Principal Judge Family Court, Chikkamagaluru, is transferred to Senior Civil Judge, Harapanahalli.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition under Section 24 CPC
advising on divorce proceedings in family court
assisting with Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 cases
